title: ExpandableText
description: Fiori expandable text: text cut at a character limit with Show More / Show Less, in place or in a popover (ui5-expandable-text).

usage.summary: Keep prose within a character limit while letting users reveal the full text.
useWhen: Let users read a description in constrained space and reveal the rest when needed.
Use maxCharacters (100 by default) with overflowMode="InPlace" or "Popover" to choose where the full text appears.

avoidWhen.when: Show body text that already fits, or truncate it without offering a reveal action.
Let users edit the prose rather than read it.
